galaxxi_black.type_zh: 暗影 符文剑士 武器·剑 （双手）
galaxxi_black.text_zh:
每回合一次行动——支付1点资源：攻击
若本回合你从你的放逐区使用过一张牌，银河黑直到回合结束获得+2力量。
若银河黑命中英雄，对该英雄造成1点秘法伤害。

Once per Turn Action - {r}: Attack
If you have played a card from your banished zone this turn, Galaxxi Black gains +2{p} until end of turn.
If Galaxxi Black hits a hero, deal 1 arcane damage to that hero.

战痕
gallantry_gold.text_en:
Action - {r}, destroy Gallantry Gold: Your weapon attacks gain +1{p} this turn. Go again
Battleworn

gallow_end_of_the_line.text_zh:
行动——支付1点资源，横置此牌：攻击
瞬间——横置此牌，弃一张具有水葬的牌：直到回合结束，对手控制的效果在其攻击命中时不触发。
水葬
gallow_end_of_the_line.text_en:
Action - {r}, {t}: Attack
Instant - {t}, discard a card with watery grave: Until end of turn, effects controlled by opponents don't trigger when their attacks hit.
Watery Grave

galvanic_bender.text_zh:

Material - While this is under a permanent, that permanent has +1{p}.
Battleworn

当此牌攻击英雄时，偷取其控制的一个光环衍生物。
若你控制3个或更多光环，此牌获得+3力量。
gang_robbery.text_en:
When this attacks a hero, steal an aura token they control.
If you control 3 or more auras, this gets +3{p}.

garland_of_spring.text_zh: 行动——摧毁此牌：获得1点资源。再动

gas_up.text_zh:
本回合你推进的下一次攻击获得+4力量。
你可以将你放逐区中的一张超频驱动器放入竞技场。
再动
gas_up.text_en:
The next attack you boost this turn gets +4{p}.
You may put a Hyper Driver from your banished zone into the arena.
Go again

gate_to_i_arathael.text_zh: 瞬间——支付1点资源，摧毁此牌：本回合你可以从你的放逐区使用目标具有血债的行动牌。

战痕
gauntlet_of_boulderhold.text_en:
Action - {r}{r}{r}, destroy this: The next Guardian attack action card you play from arsenal this turn gets +2{p}. Go again

行动——摧毁此牌：创造一个力量衍生物。再动

Action - Destroy this: Create a Might token. Go again

gauntlet_of_sword_and_sorcery.type_zh: 符文剑士 装备·手臂

Action - {r}{r}, {t} this and your hero: The next attack action card you play this turn gets "When this attacks, deal 1 arcane damage to any opposing target. If damage is dealt this way, this gets +1{p}." Go again
Arcane Barrier 1

When this defends, the next time an attack would gain {p} this chain link, instead it gains that much minus 1.

每回合一次行动——支付2点资源：若以此方式弃置的是大地牌，你本回合名称为“绞碎”的攻击获得+2力量；若是冰牌，你本回合名称为“绞碎”的攻击获得支配。再动
淬炼
gauntlets_of_the_boreal_domain.text_en:
Once per Turn Action - {r}{r}: If an Earth card is pitched this way, your attacks named Mangle get +2{p} this turn. If an Ice card is pitched this way, your attacks named Mangle get dominate this turn. Go again
Temper

gauntlets_of_tyrannical_rex.text_zh:
行动——支付1点资源，横置此牌：你本回合的下一次攻击获得+1力量。仅当你资源区中有一张力量为6或更高的牌时才能启动此异能。再动
淬炼

Action - {r}, {t}: Your next attack this turn gets +1{p}. Activate this only if there is a card with 6 or more {p} in your pitch zone. Go again

gavel_of_natural_order.text_en:
Pairs with an off-hand
Once per Turn Action - {r}{r}: Attack
Whenever an opponent plays or activates their first card or ability each turn, if it's not their turn, put a +1{p} counter on this. At the beginning of your end phase, remove all +1{p} counters from this.

若本回合你使用过另一张法师非攻击行动牌，将此牌置入其拥有者的手牌。

Opt 2
If you've played another Wizard non-attack action card this turn, put this into its owner's hand.

genesis.type_zh: 光 幻术师 瞬间·光环

在你的回合开始时，你可以将你手牌中的一张牌置入你的灵魂。若其为幻术师牌，创造一个幻质护盾衍生物。若其为光牌，抽一张牌。

genesis.text_en:
At the start of your turn, you may put a card from your hand into your soul. If it's an Illusionist card, create a Spectral Shield token. If it's a Light card, draw a card.
Spectra

genis_wotchuneed.text_en: Once per Turn Action - {r}{r}: Each other hero may put a card from their hand on the bottom of their deck. If they do, they draw a card and you create a Silver token. If you gain no Silver this way, draw a card. Go again

gentle_breeze.text_zh:
你的其他攻击具有1点基础力量。
再动

再动

Go again

若本回合此牌因推进被放逐，你可以从你的放逐区使用此牌。
进化升级——当此牌攻击时，从你的牌库中搜寻一张费用小于或等于你已装备的进化装备数量的进化牌，放逐它，然后洗牌。
ghost_protocol_architect.text_en:
If this was banished from boosting this turn, you may play this from your banished zone.
Evo Upgrade - When this attacks, search your deck for an Evo with cost less than or equal to the number of Evos you have equipped, banish it, then shuffle.

Whenever an Illusionist attack you control is destroyed by phantasm, put a haunt counter on Ghostly Touch.
Once per Turn Action - Remove a haunt counter from Ghostly Touch: Until end of turn, this becomes an Illusionist ally with phantasm, base {p} and {h} equal to the number of haunt counters on it, and "Once per Turn Action - {r}{r}{r}: Attack". Go again

ghostly_visit.text_zh:
你可以从你的放逐区使用幽灵造访。

The next 2 ally cards with watery grave you play this turn cost {r}{r}{r} less to play.
Go again

Go again

This gets +1{d} for each Toughness token that has left the arena this turn.
Guardwell

gloves_of_azure_waves.text_en:

对目标英雄造成X+3点秘法伤害，X为你控制的名称中含有印记的光环永久物数量。

创造一个敏捷和一个活力衍生物。
